evidence.summary: The UN Security Council listed the Fater (or Faater) Institute in resolution 1929 (2010), among the entities owned, controlled or acting on behalf of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), as a subsidiary of Khatam al-Anbiya Construction Headquarters (KAA). The resolution describes KAA as an IRGC-owned company that carries out large civil and military construction projects. It says Fater has worked with foreign suppliers, likely on behalf of other KAA companies on IRGC projects in Iran. OFAC lists it as Fater Engineering Institute, in Tehran, under its IRGC sanctions programme, among others.
It is a subsidiary of Khatam al-Anbiya Construction Headquarters, a company owned by Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).

sources.title: Resolution 1929 (2010), adopted by the Security Council on 9 June 2010 (S/RES/1929 (2010)), Annex II
